title: Reporter Lestari Wulandari is accused of speaking hate
paragraphs: Sulut News Reporter Lestari Wulandari was charged with hate speech related to the campaign speech candidate mayor.

According to the charges, Lestari Wulandari published a report on the campaign speech of the mayor's candidate on April 1, 2026 the prosecutors judged to spread hatred against a particular group. Article 28 verse (2) ITE Act (The teaching of hatred based on SARA).
The indictment was read at the Manado State Court on June 2, 2026, the first hearing of the witness hearing was scheduled on June 23, 2026.
In the matter of the Wulandari Lestary, the legal power of Ratna Sari protested the decision of a panel of judges who closed the hearing to observers.
Lestari Wulandari works as a Sulut news reporter in Manado, an alliance of journalists claiming to monitor the course of the trial.
The threat of punishment for this chapter is up to 6 years in prison.
